@graph.name: Space BQS Commercial License
@graph.description: Enterprise software license for bunker surveying companies and marine inspection firms. Fixed team-based subscription with zero per-job fees, unlimited PDF certificates, full mobile offline access, and cloud survey registry.

priceSpecification.description: Licensed by active surveyor seat count and monthly survey volume. Includes web portal, mobile app, and PDF certificate generation.

mainEntity.name: Are there per-job fees or transactional report charges in Space BQS?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Unlike legacy transactional marine inspection platforms that charge $15 to $50 per certificate issued, Space BQS operates strictly on a predictable team license. Survey firms can generate unlimited bunker delivery, ROB, and debunkering certificates without incremental usage fees.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the Space BQS software subscription?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every license includes full access to the offline-first mobile app for iOS and Android, the central web management portal, automated tank calibration table strapping interpolation, ASTM D1250 Table 54B VCF calculation engine, locked PDF certificate builder, 4-sheet Excel export package, and cloud Survey Warehouse archive.

mainEntity.name: Can we test Space BQS on live vessel surveys before committing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Space BQS provides qualified independent survey firms and fleet operators with a structured 30-day pilot workspace including test vessel profiles, full offline mobile licenses, and supervisor portal onboarding.
